issuing_orgs: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
synopsis: This Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) seeks support for continuation of the NIDDK George M. O'Brien Urology Cooperative Research Centers (U54). The Urology Cooperative Research Centers foster impactful, multi-disciplinary research through collaborations within and outside the Centers and serve as a national resource for the urology research community.
title: George M. O’Brien Urology Cooperative Research Centers Program (U54 Clinical Trial Optional)
